2609.11859.title: From Parameters to Answers: How LLMs Retrieve and Use Their Internal Knowledge
2609.11859.paper_summary: How does a language model's dependence on query-routing information and target knowledge change as it answers a question? We study this question through layerwise interventions on the hidden state at the end of the question. Across Qwen, Llama, and Gemma, we compare country-continent questions with noun, adjective, and code answers while keeping several fitted measurements distinct. A pair-conditioned request direction describes which country is queried in natural single-country questions; a global request direction describes first- versus second-country requests in paired questions; separate selection candidates test control among contents already available in the hidden state. A diagnostic reanalysis of frozen Qwen natural-question states shows that the pair-conditioned direction grows stronger before interventions on it begin to alter later fitted knowledge, with this causal window opening while answer-supporting content is still forming. The paired three-model trajectories are not uniform: Gemma shows a partially overlapping mid-layer routing-content profile, whereas Llama has no sustained routing-effect window under the same gates. In the paired protocol, dependence on the global request direction decreases from fixed earlier to later layer sets while dependence on fitted content persists. A matched Qwen comparison shows that the pair-conditioned direction retains a late effect, so this operational handoff concerns the global fitted direction rather than all request information. These results separate early readability, natural strength, causal steering, and later content dependence.
2609.11859.paper_summary_zh: 語言模型對查詢路由信息和目標知識的依賴在回答問題時是如何變化的？我們通過對問題結尾的隱藏狀態進行逐層干預來研究這個問題。在 Qwen、Llama 和 Gemma 之間，我們比較了國家-大陸問題與名詞、形容詞和代碼答案，同時保持幾個擬合測量的區別。一個成對條件請求方向描述了在自然單國問題中查詢的是哪個國家；一個全局請求方向描述了在成對問題中第一個和第二個國家的請求；單獨的選擇候選者測試已經在隱藏狀態中可用內容之間的控制。對凍結的 Qwen 自然問題狀態的診斷性重新分析顯示，成對條件方向在對其進行干預之前變得更強，這一因果窗口在支持答案的內容仍在形成時打開。成對的三模型軌跡並不均勻：Gemma 顯示出部分重疊的中層路由-內容特徵，而 Llama 在相同的閘門下沒有持續的路由效應窗口。在成對協議中，對全局請求方向的依賴從固定的早期層集減少到後期層集，而對擬合內容的依賴仍然存在。一個匹配的 Qwen 比較顯示，成對條件方向保持了晚期效應，因此這一操作交接關注的是全局擬合方向，而不是所有請求信息。這些結果區分了早期可讀性、自然強度、因果引導和後期內容依賴。
